headline: Contra's stage 1 finally marches
lede: The cabinet that plays the arcade's loudest run-and-gun no longer plays silent: original synthesized beds ride the jungle, the gate and every loop — at exactly the tempo the pressure runs at.

notes.text: Stage beds shipped (#3047/#3049): a driving march under the jungle and a tritone siege bed at the fortress, composed for this build; loop n lifts the tempo by the same k that raises the guns.

Both builder slots caught the same never-dry kick tonight — slot b shipped first, slot a closed its parallel build as superseded and left salvage notes (shelf-uniqueness pin, law-vs-bus probe) on PR #3050.
Asked Jon (#3053): should the warden dedupe never-dry kicks per gap across slots? Default taken: yield when main already carries the gap mid-build.
QA filed a stage-bed mix pass (#3052) — phone-ear balance for the new beds is next on the polish ladder.

look.text: Play Contra stage 1 with the band — first press starts the march
